notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: no hardware run, no real ROS run and no human review. The gate ran on the package's fake only; gym_guided_vision, MuJoCo and dm_control are not installed here and package code never imports the clone, so the upstream simulator backend (sim, gymnasium.make('gym_guided_vision/InsertPeg-3Arms-v0')) was not run and nothing was compared with the upstream simulator.

The upstream is a simulated Gymnasium environment served by GymnasiumDriver: cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action}, and the action space is the upstream's unbounded Box(-inf, inf, (21,), float32) (env.py:87), so the bridge derives no finite action limit. G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (there is no out-of-limit input to probe) and the four G8.NO_UNIT warnings (bridge-derived ticks, action.values and the two seed inputs) are therefore expected. G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 is expected too: the seed only sets the seed of the next reset and makes no native call. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue cap.world.* ids are used, so there are no catalogue_requests.

Fake disclosure: fake.py is an analytic stand-in, not a recording. It implements the upstream 21-value action layout, the observation keys and the constant terminated=False/truncated=False, but no MuJoCo physics, contacts, task objects or contact-based reward: its joints follow the commanded targets immediately and its reward is always 0. The real upstream observation is six cameras at 480x640x3 uint8 plus a 21-value agent_pos (env.py:66-85, __init__.py:9-11); the fake declares that observation space but returns a 2x2x3 placeholder image per camera to keep receipts small, as named in the fidelity gaps. The upstream reset draws the peg and hole placement from the global numpy RNG (env.py:482,489) and the registration marks the environment nondeterministic (__init__.py:92-94), so the driver fidelity says determinism statistical with seed_control none, while the bridge's capability entries say seeded because reset accepts a seed; a seed does not reproduce the upstream task placement. Fidelity level F0 reflects the unvalidated, contact-free fake.

The e-stop is the runtime's software latch; a Gymnasium environment has no native stop, and the safe-state sentence says the simulation stops advancing while the state stays readable. No physical e-stop is claimed. driver.lock.json authored_by is model deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run retriage-drivers-1-045) and reviewed_by stays null. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review checked all recon entry classes and selected InsertPeg source; driver.py corrects registration/reward fact clauses, discloses omitted tasks and ROS/Interbotix hardware, records the assets licence and limits the stop claim to the lockstep fake. Fake fidelity is now explicitly analytic F0 with exact, seed-independent output rather than upstream statistical determinism; test_driver.py checks that published contract. facts.md, reference.json and REFERENCE.md were synchronized, and check-report.json was regenerated. The fake gate and strict collector pass with contract_checked evidence, and a direct fake probe confirms seed-independent resets; no upstream simulator, ROS graph or hardware execution is claimed. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Owner publication decision remains required: the repository card licence is NOASSERTION; the Trossen Robotics assets three-clause notice does not establish a licence for all code. Only InsertPeg-3Arms is served; RealEnv.reset reboots motors and moves arms through ROS/Interbotix and is excluded. The fake has no contacts/task objects and returns 2x2x3 placeholder images rather than six 480x640x3 cameras. The copied action Box is unbounded with mixed joint-position and normalized-gripper units; no finite device envelope or physical stop is claimed.
